divergences.reason: Authorized source-faithful translation of active configured POLYSELF, all form/anatomy/equipment/command policy remains JavaScript.
divergences.effect: No active game change while private; intended replacement preserves the configured original routines through typed memory64 transport.
implementation: Original function names, formal bindings/order and all 218 original block comments retained across all 34 routines. The C local class is named mclass because class is reserved in JavaScript.
The eight original static helpers are module exports for JS composition and typed private probes; no original gameplay body remains in support C.
Original newman dead and polyself selection/retry/special-form joins are explicit JS labels/joins, with no native gameplay fallback.
C char arrays use native stack buffers; 47 intra-TU calls preserve automatic-storage lifetime through callLocal stack scopes.
Signed64 fields/constants use BigInt; complete attribute structs copy native bytes; record identity is canonical by type/native address within a call.
Observed C &&/|| values and C !! array indices are canonical integers; conditions preserve short-circuit evaluation.
Header macros remain explicit JavaScript; native helper code is generated field/global/address/read/write, literal backing, exact original variadic signatures and RNG attribution.

Production filename is derived from fresh configured CPP invoked as basename polyself.c; private original-source include prefix mapping produces that exact spelling. Raw trace filenames are compared without normalization.
Generated varargs wrappers intentionally forward dynamic formats and the exact original argument list. Clang -Wformat-security is scoped off only around these wrappers; no injected %s argument.
divergences.inheritedSourceChanges: Prepared source is byte-identical to pinned upstream polyself.c; selected STATUS_HILITES is enabled, DUMB is disabled, three original #if0 blocks remain inactive.
coverage: All 34 configured routines and all 31 source RNG sites execute in the original-C oracle.
567 controlled cases / 8947 return, full relevant native-state, exact dependency-argument trace, stack, identity, growth/reentry and negative-control checks.
Both early and nested newman dead joins, class retry and all four special polyself joins are directly covered.
limitations: Native-host independent oracle is pending; Emscripten compiled C is the reference for this first pass.
Full game integration, original-deadline checks and recording equivalence are pending root integration.
Controlled foreign dependencies do not establish every real game callback outcome or exhaustive branch coverage.
Injected JavaScript exceptions validate binding/stack cleanup; this is not a native panic/longjmp equivalence claim.
Pointer snapshot normalization is restricted to typed pointers/known native regions and text content; scalar coincidence negative controls remain strict.
